title.en: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) vs World Food Programme (WFP)
title.hi: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) vs World Food Programme (WFP)

rows.en: Knowledge-based organization focusing on policy, research, and technical assistance.
rows.hi: Knowledge-based organization focusing on policy, research, and technical assistance.

rows.en: Operational agency focused on emergency food assistance and logistics.
rows.hi: Operational agency focused on emergency food assistance and logistics.

rows.en: Normative and standard-setting in agriculture and nutrition.
rows.hi: Normative and standard-setting in agriculture and nutrition.

rows.en: Direct humanitarian aid and disaster relief operations.
rows.hi: Direct humanitarian aid and disaster relief operations.

rows.en: Both are specialized agencies or programs under the United Nations system.
rows.hi: Both are specialized agencies or programs under the United Nations system.

rows.en: Both work towards the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal 2 (Zero Hunger).
rows.hi: Both work towards the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal 2 (Zero Hunger).

clarification.en: FAO provides the policy framework and technical expertise, while WFP executes the physical distribution of food in crisis zones.
clarification.hi: FAO provides the policy framework and technical expertise, while WFP executes the physical distribution of food in crisis zones.

relationship.en: FAO provides technical support for India's sustainable farming practices and food security policies.
relationship.hi: FAO provides technical support for India's sustainable farming practices and food security policies.
